pineroot_scout.name: Scout Maren
pineroot_scout.intro: The pines whisper, but my monsters don't!
pineroot_scout.defeat: You listened well to the forest!

hollow_forager.name: Forager Tam
hollow_forager.intro: My mushrooms are safe. My monsters are NOT!

ridge_climber.name: Climber Wendel
ridge_climber.intro: I train on the ridge. Care for a match?

glade_warden.name: Glade Warden Sula
glade_warden.intro: Few reach the glade. Show me your fire!
glade_warden.defeat: The glade accepts you, fierce hunter!

emmett_1.name: Emmett
emmett_1.intro: Hey squirt! Race you to the top of the leaderboard!
emmett_1.defeat: Whoa. Okay, you're getting good at this!

emmett_2.name: Emmett
emmett_2.intro: Again? You never quit! Let's see your progress!
emmett_2.defeat: You've really grown. Better watch MY back!

emmett_3.name: Emmett
emmett_3.intro: Final rival match! Winner claims hunter glory!
emmett_3.defeat: You did it, squirt. You're officially better than me!

lines: My sister says Storm monsters zap Leaf ones!
Water beats Ember. Ask anyone at the spring!
Weaken a monster before you trap it, dear.
Stout Traps open up when you get stronger!
